subject: [PATCH 36/60] mm: refuse explicit reclaim and compaction of private nodes

reviews.author: Gregory Price (Meta)
reviews.summary: The patch series aims to prevent double-put bugs by rejecting explicit reclaim and compaction requests for private nodes. However, memoryless nodes continue to accept these requests.

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses memory management issues in the Linux kernel by modifying how reclaim and compaction operations are handled on private nodes. The changes involve adding checks to reject explicit reclaim and compaction requests for private nodes, preventing potential double-put bugs.
